items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: But I mean, I know about him! In that style.

ctx.x: And Charlie Parker, Dizzy Gillespie, a lot of them -- well, he could back them up. Knew how to play on different things, tom-toms, whatever it is -- he knew how. He was a great drummer. Of course, I didn't put no other drummers down. But I mean, I know about him! In that style.
And he impressed you early on.
